notes: Six wrappers 00711F50/00711F90/00711FD0/00712010/00712050/00712090 differ only in their tail-jump target (0075A3B0, 0075A3C0, 0075A3D0, 0075A3E0, 0075A3F0, 0075A400); per rule 1 the rows cite the jump by site, so their sentences are identical. 007114F0: the error path is taken whenever a pointer is given and byte +0x464 is nonzero, whatever the mode. 007116A0: when the second tree holds a nonzero value, 007114F0 is still called with r8 = null (the first lookup's result); worth a second look. 00712910: if no component exceeds the initial maximum the final store goes to index -1 (rcx-4); with non-negative components and a -FLT_MAX-like start this should not occur. 00713900: stack-argument mapping assumes rbp = entry rsp - 0x47 (fifth = [rbp+0x6f], sixth = [rbp+0x77], seventh = [rbp+0x7f]); same for 007125B0.
